description: stats19 is an R package from the rOpenSci project for obtaining and preparing Great Britain road-injury collision records. Its functions download selected years and tables from the official STATS19 release, read their coded fields, and add human-readable labels. The package returns R tables or simple-feature spatial objects with a suitable coordinate reference system. Coverage is the national dataset that the user selects, not observations collected by the package itself; the time span follows the source release. The public repository and R package documentation provide installation and function examples, free under GPL-3.0. The prepared collision, vehicle and casualty records can help calibrate or evaluate road-safety simulations and compare exposure near network links or interventions. The package does not create crash observations and inherits under-reporting and coding changes in the official data. It also downloads data during use, so users need to check the source release and any sensitive-field restrictions separately. The related catalogue record data-gb-road-safety-open-data-stats19 covers the government data, not this independent software. The code was inspected through its documentation and metadata; no data were downloaded or functions executed.
